These 20 questions exist so you can run the bot end to end (import, schedule,

Replace this file with your own licensed question bank before going live.
Delete it from data/ once you do, or its questions will keep appearing in the
id          required, stable. The natural key with `source` - re-importing
the same id updates in place instead of inserting a duplicate.
question    required. Clamped to 300 characters (Telegram poll limit).
options     required, exactly 4. Each clamped to 100 characters.
or `correct_answer` to give the answer as text.
explanation optional. Clamped to 200 characters, shown after answering.
image       optional URL. Downloaded once at import and cached on disk.
CSV and XLSX work too - see README.md for the column layout.

questions.question: Svetoforning qizil chirog'i yonib turganda haydovchi nima qilishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Qizil chiroq harakatni taqiqlaydi. To'xtash chizig'i oldida to'xtash shart.

questions.question: Svetoforning sariq chirog'i yonganda nima qilish kerak?
options: Harakatni to'xtatish va yashil chiroqni kutish
questions.explanation: Sariq chiroq harakatni taqiqlaydi va signal almashishidan ogohlantiradi.

questions.question: Haydovchi qonuniy ravishda transport vositasini boshqarishi uchun qondagi alkogol miqdori qanday bo'lishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Alkogol ta'siri ostida transport vositasini boshqarish butunlay taqiqlanadi.

questions.question: Xavfsizlik kamari qachon taqilishi shart?
questions.explanation: Xavfsizlik kamari harakat davomida doimo taqilgan bo'lishi shart.

questions.question: Tartibga solinmagan piyodalar o'tish joyiga yaqinlashayotgan haydovchi nima qilishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Piyodalar o'tish joyida piyodalar ustunlikka ega.

questions.question: Uchburchak shaklidagi, qizil hoshiyali yo'l belgilari qanday belgilar hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: Qizil hoshiyali uchburchak belgilar xavf haqida ogohlantiradi.

questions.question: Doira shaklidagi, qizil hoshiyali belgilar nimani bildiradi?
questions.explanation: Qizil hoshiyali doiraviy belgilar taqiqlovchi belgilar hisoblanadi.

questions.question: Teng ahamiyatli chorrahada haydovchi kimga yo'l berishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Teng ahamiyatli chorrahada o'ng tomondan kelayotgan transport ustunlikka ega.

questions.question: Quyidagi holatlarning qaysi birida quvib o'tish taqiqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Piyodalar o'tish joyida va unga yaqinlashishda quvib o'tish taqiqlanadi.

questions.question: Tezlikni tanlashda haydovchi nimaga asoslanishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Tezlik yo'l sharoiti, ko'rinish va harakat jadalligiga mos bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: Tunda yoritilmagan yo'lda qanday chiroqlardan foydalanish kerak?
questions.explanation: Tunda yoritilmagan yo'lda faralar yoqilgan bo'lishi shart.

questions.question: Qarama-qarshi transport yaqinlashganda uzoq nurli farani nima qilish kerak?
questions.explanation: Qarshi haydovchini ko'r qilmaslik uchun yaqin nurga o'tish shart.

questions.question: Oldindagi transport vositasi bilan masofa nimaga bog'liq holda tanlanadi?
questions.explanation: Masofa to'satdan to'xtashda to'qnashuvning oldini olishga yetarli bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: Temir yo'l kesishmasiga yaqinlashayotgan haydovchi nima qilishi kerak?
options: Tezlikni pasaytirib, poyezd yo'qligiga ishonch hosil qilish
questions.explanation: Temir yo'l kesishmasida poyezdlar so'zsiz ustunlikka ega.

questions.question: Avariya to'xtash signali qachon yoqilishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Avariya signali boshqa haydovchilarni xavf haqida ogohlantiradi.

questions.question: Yomg'irli va sirpanchiq yo'lda haydovchi nima qilishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Sirpanchiq yo'lda tormozlash masofasi sezilarli darajada uzayadi.

questions.question: Ko'k rangli chiroq va ovoz signali yoqilgan maxsus transport yaqinlashganda nima qilish kerak?
questions.explanation: Maxsus signalli transport vositalari so'zsiz ustunlikka ega.

questions.question: Burilishdan oldin haydovchi qanday harakat qilishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Burilish ko'rsatkichi manyovrdan oldin yoqilib, boshqalarni ogohlantiradi.

questions.question: Maktab yaqinidagi yo'l qismida haydovchi nimaga alohida e'tibor berishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Bolalar yo'l harakatida eng himoyasiz qatnashchilar hisoblanadi.

questions.question: Transport vositasini boshqarish paytida qo'lda telefondan foydalanish qanday baholanadi?
questions.explanation: Qo'lda telefondan foydalanish diqqatni chalg'itadi va taqiqlanadi.
